title: Extension of a stalkwise pairing to Godement tensor coordinates
statement: Given a stalkwise pairing satisfying the represented-germ formula, there is a family of Godement tensor maps whose evaluated coordinates equal that pairing.

proof.text: Choose the canonical stalk tensor isomorphisms from stalkTensorIso. Their pure-tensor germ formula agrees definitionally with moduleCup_sectionTensor.

Represent any two stalk elements on open neighbourhoods and restrict both representatives to their intersection. The hypothesis ht and the tensor comparison germ formula imply that the given t is the inverse comparison applied to a pure tensor.

Compose each Godement projection on stalks with skyscraperStalkEval. Tensor these two linear maps and compose with the forward tensor comparison on the Godement objects and the inverse comparison on H and K. Apply toSkyscraper to the resulting linear map and assemble all coordinates with Pi.lift.

Use Pi.lift_π, toSkyscraper_app_apply, the stalk tensor germ formula, TensorProduct.map_tmul, and the identification with t. Hom.stalkLinearMap_germ and skyscraperStalkEval_germ reduce the two factors to the displayed section coordinates.

proof_origin.place: §1.1.4, pp. 15–16; Stacks Tags 0FKR and 01CB; E3 second reader uses the existing stalkTensorIso and stalk–skyscraper adjunction to construct the coordinate maps.

theorem moduleCup_godement_tensor_map_of_pairing_exists (X : Scheme.{u})
    (t : ∀ (H K : X.Modules) (x : X),
      H.presheaf.stalk x → K.presheaf.stalk x → (H ⊗ K).presheaf.stalk x)
    (ht : ∀ (H K : X.Modules) (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U)
        (s : Γ(H, U)) (r : Γ(K, U)),
      t H K x (H.presheaf.germ U x hx s) (K.presheaf.germ U x hx r) =
        (H ⊗ K).presheaf.germ U x hx
          ((moduleCup_sectionTensor X H K).app (op U)
            (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] r))) :
    ∃ b : ∀ H K : X.Modules,
      moduleCup_godementObject X H ⊗ moduleCup_godementObject X K ⟶
        moduleCup_godementObject X (H ⊗ K),
      ∀ (H K : X.Modules) (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U)
        (s : Γ(moduleCup_godementObject X H, U))
        (r : Γ(moduleCup_godementObject X K, U)),
      (moduleCup_sectionTensor X (moduleCup_godementObject X H)
          (moduleCup_godementObject X K) ≫ (b H K).val ≫
        (Pi.π (fun y : X ↦ skyscraper y ((H ⊗ K).presheaf.stalk y)) x).val).app
          (op U) (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] r) ⟨hx⟩ =
        t H K x
          ((Pi.π (fun y : X ↦ skyscraper y (H.presheaf.stalk y)) x).app U s ⟨hx⟩)
          ((Pi.π (fun y : X ↦ skyscraper y (K.presheaf.stalk y)) x).app U r ⟨hx⟩)
